column10: Stuxnet is typically introduced to the target environment via an infected USB flash drive.

column9: A threat actor, using a tool dubbed Duqu 2.0, targeted individuals and companies linked to the P5+1 (the five permanent member states of the UN Security Council, plus Germany), which was conducting negotiations on Iran's nuclear program.
